svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Indicator: cut 40 mm of clear polycarbonate tube, 6 mm outside,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4 mm bore. Seal one end with a 3 mm plug of the epoxy; cure.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Warm the grade's PCM just above its melting point and fill the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tube with a syringe, leaving a 2 mm bubble; seal the other end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with 3 mm of epoxy. Solid PCM is white, liquid PCM is clear.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Guards: two 40 mm lengths of the fin bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: bond the indicator to the painted top with the epoxy, along

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the cartridge, 30 mm toward the back from the centre line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: between 16 and 56 mm from the handle end of the tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bond a guard on edge 8 mm each side of it; the guards are as

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tall as the fins and take knocks.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The label is notched round them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no PCM weeps at the plugs when warmed by hand.
